scripts.probe:workflow: tsx scripts/isolated-saas-preference-probe.ts && tsx scripts/isolated-workflow-recovery-probe.ts && tsx scripts/isolated-tunnel-route-probe.ts && tsx scripts/isolated-request-param-probe.ts && tsx scripts/isolated-backend-safe-probe.ts && tsx scripts/isolated-backend-careful-probe.ts && tsx scripts/isolated-default-config-probe.ts && tsx scripts/isolated-saas-config-branch-probe.ts && npm run probe:requests
scripts.probe:functional: tsx scripts/isolated-frontend-audit-probe.ts && tsx scripts/isolated-saas-dns-repair-probe.ts && tsx scripts/isolated-stability-readability-probe.ts && tsx --tsconfig web/tsconfig.json scripts/isolated-dns-import-probe.ts && tsx --tsconfig web/tsconfig.json scripts/isolated-edge-one-command-probe.ts
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run version:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:web && npm run test && npm run arch:final && npm run deadcode && npm run deps:check && npm run routes:check && npm run probe:api && npm run probe:job && npm run probe:query && npm run probe:platform && npm run probe:workflow && npm run probe:reconcile && npm run probe:audit && npm run probe:functional && npm run probe:security && npm run build && npm run probe:static
